AgentEvent.description: `type = "event"` payload: something this session cares about happened. The poster only describes the event; whether it is an Input or an Observe is decided by the receiving session's subscriptions.

data_ref.description: ObjId or a path relative to the session directory.

seq.description: Version inside the source; Observe merging compares it.

subscription_id.description: Explicit subscription id; may be empty for implicit subscriptions.

summary.description: One sentence for the LLM (≤ 1 KB); never parsed mechanically.

action_whitelist.description: Named tools offered as actions (behavior loop).

tool_whitelist.description: Tools offered as native functions (`None`: the session's tools). An entry is a tool name or `group:<builtin group>`.

BehaviorConfig.description: One behavior of the agent, includes expanded.

BehaviorEntryConfig.description: How the behavior is entered (decided by the target, §3.3). `mode` may only be left out by a session's entry behavior (`switch_context`).

todo.description: A hand-over to this behavior (`next_behavior`) executes the session's next serial Todo: the host admits it and hands its body over as the sub task (`create_sub_context` only).

BehaviorLoop.description: Loop of the behavior's own context.

next.description: Behaviors this one may hand over to or call: the frozen closure.

goal_activation.description: Goal Sessions: template of the Goal header (variable `goal`).

system.description: System template of the behavior's context.

BehaviorReply.description: `[reply]`: the reply contract of a behavior's context. The final reply (an assistant text without tool calls) is one JSON value matching `schema`: the provider enforces it natively where it can, the host checks it and asks for one correction (`OutputSpec::Json { max_repairs: Some(1) }`). Function call loop only.

asks_field.description: An array field of the reply that must list every question the context asked the user (`agent-session ask-user`), one entry each.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the reply (an object schema).

BehaviorToolConfig.description: `[tool]`: a sub context behavior offered to its callers as a named function. Calling it runs the behavior exactly like `call_behavior` does; the declaration only decides what the caller's model sees.

description.description: When to call it: the caller's routing guide.

name.description: Function name (letters, digits, `_`); default: the behavior name.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of the arguments (an object); default: `{task: string}`.

task.description: Template of the sub context's task (`{{args.<name>}}` only); default: the arguments as JSON (or `args.task` with the default parameters).

outbound.description: Where the session's replies go, fixed when it is created: a reply whose route differs is not sent.

wake_event.description: kevent id published after posting; every segment only uses letters, digits and `_ - .`.

CmdSkill.description: `prompt.frozen.cmd_skills[]`: a command manual of the session, frozen with its behaviors (`cmd_skills/<name>.md` without its front matter).

ComputerAccess.description: ComputerUse capability of an Agent on a runtime: `none` grants no Computer operation, `observe` grants inspect/observe, `control` adds act.

ContextMode.description: How a behavior is entered when a hand-over (`next_behavior`) or a `call_behavior` tool call names it. Decided by the target behavior, never by the session as a whole; there is no default mode.

oneOf.description: The target has its own context (system, tools, history, run): created on first entry, resumed from its own snapshot afterwards.
A new sub context per call with the target's system and task input, plus an explicit selection of the caller's history; its result returns to the caller.
A new branch per call that keeps the caller's system and its complete effective history at the fork point; its result returns to the caller.

ControlCommand.description: `type = "control"` payload: session control, executed by the runner. Never enters the LLM context and produces no input receipt.

scope.description: `session` (default): the session finishes as stopped. `turn`: only the open Turn closes as stopped and the session goes on waiting. A Goal Session only ever stops its open Turn (it ends with its Goal).

oneOf.description: The only input a finished session still accepts.
Activity declaration (e.g. `agent-session activity --touch <ref>`).
A perception of this session (Memory §4.2): the model gives content and hints, the driver binds identity, subjects, source event, time and policy through `Memory::record_perception`.

cites.description: Cognitions (`item_…@rev`) the observation derives from or corrects.

memory_intent.description: `explicit` when the user asked to remember.

source.description: Input key of the message of this session the observation comes from (`None`: the observation itself is the event).

subjects.description: Narrows the session's default subjects (must stay within its grants).

oneOf.description: Goal Sessions: change the Goal's current skills (applied by the driver to the Goal State it owns).

principal.description: Driving identity = the appid of the driving process (Q9 / Q16).

oneOf.description: Finish after `detail.n` (default 1) completed logical Turns; between them the session waits for input. Internal hand-overs (context switch, sub context call / return) are not Turns and cost nothing.

id.description: object: object id; session: sid; task: task_id; timer: timer name; system: may be empty.

kind.description: `object | session | task | timer | system`; unknown kinds are not a format error (an event without a matching subscription is dropped).

FrozenPrompt.description: `prompt.frozen`: what the session took from the behavior catalog when it was constructed. Later catalog changes never reach the session; a behavior used for the first time afterwards is added once (`control_applied{behavior_frozen}` in the worklog).

catalog_rev.description: Catalog revision at the first freeze (audit).

cmd_skills.description: The session's cmd_skills (`prompt.cmd_skills`, in that order), frozen once.

FrozenRuntime.description: The runtime a session was frozen to at creation: the registration it resolved to and how that runtime is reached, so a restart or a changed default never moves the session to another target.

GoalBinding.description: `session.goal` of a Goal Session: the Goal it works for. The definition is read from the Goal, never copied here.

GoalOrigin.description: `origin.goal` of a Work created by a Goal Session.

GoalSkill.description: A method / capability the Goal works with (architecture §10.2).

ref.description: Where it is read (path, object id, behavior name).

InheritMode.description: History a new context starts with (besides its system and task input).

oneOf.description: The session history rendered by the host (summary + recent worklog records): a filtered view, labelled `<session_history>`.
The caller's completed steps as structured records (`create_sub_context`, both contexts in the behavior loop).

InputMedia.description: Whether attachments also enter the context as image / document blocks.

oneOf.description: Text references only (`<attachment .../>` lines); the agent reads attachments with tools.
Image / document attachments additionally as content blocks (at most [`MAX_INLINE_MEDIA`] per batch).

InputMode.description: How many selected inputs one `on_input` batch takes.

oneOf.description: One msg / Input event per batch; the rest stays queued.
As many as the batch budget allows.

InputSection.description: Input consumption policy of a context (separate from its templates).

oneOf.description: kmsg queue input (all sessions).

MechanicalCompress.description: Mechanical compression parameters for rendering worklog history (§4.4).

recent_full_responses.description: Model responses rendered in full, counted from the newest: the unit is one recorded response, i.e. a behavior `step` or a function call `assistant_message` (with the entries after it). Older entries are cut to `summary_chars`.

context.description: An earlier message of the conversation, delivered as material for the input that follows it: it never forms an input batch alone, and it carries no request of its own.

conversation_name.description: Display name of the conversation (group name).

ObserveScope.description: Material of the semi-subscription snapshot and the fresh view.

created_by_call.description: `<run_id>/<call_id>` of the tool call that created the session.

goal.description: Created by an Activation of a Goal: the Goal and the revision the Work was given (kept when the Goal is revised later).

parent_task.description: Task of the parent's Turn that created the session: the parent of every task this session's Turns get.

report.description: How the parent session hears about this session (chosen by the parent when it created it). `None`: no implicit reporting.

OutboundBinding.description: Reply coordinates of a session bound to one conversation.

PostedInput.description: Producer side: one logical record to post.

at_ms.description: Posting time; display / diagnosis only, never ordering.

from.description: Poster principal (self-reported, audit only): neither the speaker nor a source of permissions.

key.description: Dedup key of the logical input: a re-post keeps it, another input uses another one. `msg`: the message's ObjId.

PromptSection.description: Prompt configuration: a superset of xllm's `.llm_context` (§4.2).

behavior.description: Entry behavior of the session (`behaviors/<name>` of the agent).

cmd_skills.description: The cmd_skills of the session (`<agent_root>/cmd_skills/<name>.md`, at most [`super::behavior::MAX_CMD_SKILLS`]): chosen when the session is created (`agent.toml [session.<class>] default_cmd_skills`, `create-worksession --cmd-skill`), frozen with the behaviors (`frozen.cmd_skills`) and rendered as `## Commands`.

compact_ratio.description: Compact after a run once the history uses more than this ratio of the budget (`maybe_compact`).

context.description: Initial context material supplied by the application.

frozen.description: Behaviors and identity frozen from the agent's catalog.

goal_activation.description: Goal Sessions: the Goal header placed before the first batch of an Activation (variable `goal`).

history_budget_tokens.description: Context budget (tokens) available to the history section when the next llm_context is assembled. `None` → runner default.

initial_inputs.description: Bootstrap inputs of a session created without an input queue: `msg` records only, at most [`super::input::MAX_PENDING_INPUTS`], never changed after creation. The runner reads them as the read-only source [`BOOTSTRAP_SRC`] (index from 1).

input.description: Input consumption of the session's base context.

llm_context.description: JSON form of an xllm `.llm_context` file (same schema, strict keys). xllm can resume a run of this session without understanding the OpenDAN extensions below.

on_context_switch.description: Hand-over into the target context (switch, sub context, its return).

semi_subscription_snapshot.description: The snapshot message placed before a controlled input.

system.description: Application system prompt (S-05); composed after the agent identity and the non-overridable constraints.

ReportMode.description: What a parent receives from a sub session without subscribing: the registry state stays the truth, these events only accelerate.

oneOf.description: Needs attention (waiting for input / a decision) and the end: Input.
`final` plus progress, kept as semi-subscription state.
Nothing is pushed; the parent reads the registry itself.
The owner's desktop host (`host`): a node's embedded executor.
Another node's embedded executor.

app_tools.description: Tools that only exist inside the runner process; verified on every drive (§7.1).

tools.description: Executables that must be reachable on PATH.

frozen.description: Set by `create_session`; `None` only in sessions created by tests without an Agent State, which run in the agent's own environment.

RuntimeSelection.description: How a session's runtime was chosen (integration TODO §3.3).

oneOf.description: Named by the creator (`--runtime`, a Todo's runtime).
The runtime of the selected workspace.
The parent session's frozen runtime.
The agent's default runtime.

Scope.description: Initial activity declaration: what this session plans to modify (§6.7).

oneOf.description: The context of a Goal (`state/goals/<goal_id>`): one per `(goal, epoch)`, created by the host, never a sub session.

SessionMsg.description: `type = "msg"` payload: the message object as it is plus what a MsgObject does not carry by design.

msg.description: cyfs-ndn MsgObject v2, never rewritten or trimmed.

SessionPolicy.description: `session.policy`: the session template resolved at creation (xAgent §4.7) and frozen with the session.

ask_user_timeout_secs.description: A session without a user reading it (a Work) asks through a notification and waits at most this long for the answer.

max_process_depth.description: Callers on `process_stack` at most (sub contexts in progress).

max_session_depth.description: Nesting depth of sub sessions below this session's root.

max_sub_sessions.description: Sub sessions not finished at the same time.

goal.description: Goal Sessions: the Goal and epoch.

owner.description: The agent's owner (DID), when the host knows it: a UI session tells its peer apart from the owner by it.

timezone.description: User time zone bound to the session (IANA name). Never the runner machine's zone: protocol times are UTC, and this value is shown to the agent through the default semi subscription ([`USER_TIMEZONE_SUBSCRIPTION`]).

oneOf.description: A matching event is an Input: it wakes the session and enters a controlled input batch.
A matching event is an Observe: merged into `pending_events` and shown as the semi-subscription snapshot before the next controlled input; never triggers inference by itself.
Another session of the same agent (pull: registry rev compare; always observed). Also matches bus events with `source = session:<ref>`.
Object events bridged into the bus (`source = object:<object>`). `event` empty or `*` matches every event name.
A task (`source = task:<task_id>`).
A timer (`source = timer:<name>`).
A system source (`source = system:<id>`).
The Turn stays open waiting for input.
Nobody answers: the Turn fails with `needs_user_input` and the session finishes as failed; the question is in the report.
Treated as the delivered result.
Nobody answers now: the Turn ends (needs input), the session goes on waiting for its next input (Goal Sessions).
